//! Notes: the entity (it mirrors the migration), its relations and its label. Validation is in
//! params.rs, the queries in queries.rs; both are re-exported here (`note::find`, `note::NoteParams`).

mod queries;

pub use queries::*;

    pub updated_at: DateTimeUtc,
    // samples: columns

    // samples: relations

=== create src/models/note/params.rs
//! Note input: `NoteParams` (untrusted, all strings) → `validate()` → `NewNote` (typed).
//! Generated by `cargo offrails generate model Note title:string:unique body:text`.

use serde::Deserialize;

use super::Model;
use crate::models::Errors;

/// Untrusted input from the note form. This struct IS the permit list. All strings, so a
/// failed submit re-renders exactly what was typed.
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Deserialize)]
pub struct NoteParams {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub title: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub body: String,
}

/// Validated, typed values. Only `NoteParams::validate` makes one.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct NewNote {
    pub title: String,
    pub body: String,
}

impl NoteParams {
    /// Rails wording: "can't be blank", "is too long (maximum is N characters)".
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<NewNote, Errors> {
        let mut errors = Errors::default();
        let title = self.title.trim();
        if title.is_empty() {
            errors.add("title", "can't be blank");
        } else if title.chars().count() > 255 {
            errors.add("title", "is too long (maximum is 255 characters)");
        }
        let body = self.body.trim();
        if body.is_empty() {
            errors.add("body", "can't be blank");
        } else if body.chars().count() > 100000 {
            errors.add("body", "is too long (maximum is 100000 characters)");
        }
        errors.into_result(|| NewNote {
            title: title.to_owned(),
            body: body.to_owned(),
        })
    }
}

/// Prefills the edit form.
impl From<&Model> for NoteParams {
    fn from(r: &Model) -> Self {
        Self {
            title: r.title.clone(),
            body: r.body.clone(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn valid() -> NoteParams {
        NoteParams {
            title: "Title".into(),
            body: "Body text".into(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn valid_params_validate() {
        assert!(valid().validate().is_ok(), "{:?}", valid().validate());
    }

    #[test]
    fn required_fields_cant_be_blank() {
        let errors = NoteParams::default().validate().unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(errors.on("title"), ["can't be blank"]);
        assert_eq!(errors.on("body"), ["can't be blank"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn strings_have_a_maximum_length() {
        let at_max = NoteParams {
            title: "x".repeat(255),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert!(at_max.validate().is_ok());
        let over = NoteParams {
            title: "x".repeat(256),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            over.validate().unwrap_err().on("title"),
            ["is too long (maximum is 255 characters)"]
        );
        let at_max = NoteParams {
            body: "x".repeat(100000),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert!(at_max.validate().is_ok());
        let over = NoteParams {
            body: "x".repeat(100001),
            ..valid()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            over.validate().unwrap_err().on("body"),
            ["is too long (maximum is 100000 characters)"]
        );
    }

}

=== create src/models/note/queries.rs
//! Notes queries. Generated by `cargo offrails generate model Note title:string:unique body:text`.

use chrono::Utc;
use sea_orm::{ActiveValue::Set, QueryOrder, QuerySelect, entity::prelude::*};

use super::{ActiveModel, Column, Entity, Model, NewNote};
use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::models::{Errors, Page};

/// Public: anyone may read any note (`--public`; .offrails/guides/models.md#scoped-lookups-tenancy).
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(id))]
pub async fn find(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, id: i64) -> Result<Model, AppError> {
    Entity::find_by_id(id).one(db).await?.ok_or(AppError::NotFound)
}

/// A page of notes, newest first, and whether there's another page.
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn all(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, page: Page) -> Result<(Vec<Model>, bool), AppError> {
    let per = page.per();
    let mut rows = Entity::find()
        .order_by_desc(Column::CreatedAt)
        .order_by_desc(Column::Id)
        .limit(per + 1)
        .offset(page.offset())
        .all(db)
        .await?;
    let more = rows.len() as u64 > per;
    rows.truncate(per as usize);
    Ok((rows, more))
}

/// Notes for a `<select>`: (id, label), at most 200, by label.
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn choices(db: &impl ConnectionTrait) -> Result<Vec<(i64, String)>, AppError> {
    let rows = Entity::find().order_by_desc(Column::Id).limit(200).all(db).await?;
    let mut out: Vec<(i64, String)> = rows.iter().map(|r| (r.id, r.label())).collect();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.cmp(&b.1));
    Ok(out)
}

/// A unique index said no: a validation error on its field, not a 500
/// (.offrails/guides/models.md#validations).
fn map_unique(e: DbErr) -> AppError {
    if let Some(sea_orm::SqlErr::UniqueConstraintViolation(msg)) = e.sql_err() {
        if msg.contains("notes_title_key") || msg.contains("notes.title") {
            return AppError::Invalid(Errors::single("title", "has already been taken"));
        }
        return AppError::Invalid(Errors::single("base", "has already been taken"));
    }
    e.into()
}

#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn create(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, new: NewNote) -> Result<Model, AppError> {
    let now = Utc::now();
    ActiveModel {
        title: Set(new.title),
        body: Set(new.body),
        created_at: Set(now),
        updated_at: Set(now),
        ..Default::default()
    }
    .insert(db)
    .await
    .map_err(map_unique)
}

#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(id = record.id))]
pub async fn update(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, record: Model, new: NewNote) -> Result<Model, AppError> {
    let mut am: ActiveModel = record.into();
    am.title = Set(new.title);
    am.body = Set(new.body);
    am.updated_at = Set(Utc::now());
    am.update(db).await.map_err(map_unique)
}

#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(id = record.id))]
pub async fn destroy(db: &impl ConnectionTrait, record: Model) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    Entity::delete_by_id(record.id).exec(db).await?;
    Ok(())
}

=== create tests/app/factories/note.rs
//! Notes test data (.offrails/guides/testing.md#factories-testsappfactoriesrs): valid params
//! through `validate` + `create`, so a test can't build an invalid row. Generated by `cargo offrails generate model Note title:string:unique body:text`.

/// Valid NoteParams (unique values numbered), for forms and `note_with`.
pub async fn note_params(db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection) -> offrails_app::models::note::NoteParams {
    let _ = db; // no parent records to create
    static N: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize = std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(1);
    let n = N.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    offrails_app::models::note::NoteParams {
        title: format!("Title {n}"),
        body: format!("Body {n}, long enough to read."),
    }
}

/// A note, through `NoteParams::validate` + `note::create`.
pub async fn note(db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection) -> offrails_app::models::note::Model {
    let params = note_params(db).await;
    note_with(db, params).await
}

/// A note from these params (they must be valid).
pub async fn note_with(
    db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection,
    params: offrails_app::models::note::NoteParams,
) -> offrails_app::models::note::Model {
    let new = params.validate().expect("valid note params");
    offrails_app::models::note::create(db, new).await.expect("create note")
}

/// Reads a note back through the entity (tests can't call the model-private `find`).
pub async fn reload_note(db: &sea_orm::DatabaseConnection, id: i64) -> Option<offrails_app::models::note::Model> {
    use sea_orm::EntityTrait;
    offrails_app::models::note::Entity::find_by_id(id)
        .one(db)
        .await
        .expect("reload note")
}

=== create tests/app/models/note_test.rs
//! `note` (src/models/note/) against the database: ordering, paging, uniqueness.
//! Generated by `cargo offrails generate model Note title:string:unique body:text`.

use offrails_app::error::AppError;
use offrails_app::models::{Page, note};

use crate::factories;
use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn all_pages_newest_first() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let first = factories::note(app.db()).await;
    let second = factories::note(app.db()).await;
    let third = factories::note(app.db()).await;
    let (rows, more) = note::all(app.db(), Page::new(1, 2)).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows, vec![third, second]);
    assert!(more);
    let (rows, more) = note::all(app.db(), Page::new(2, 2)).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows, vec![first]);
    assert!(!more);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn update_and_destroy() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::note(app.db()).await;
    let new = factories::note_params(app.db()).await.validate().unwrap();
    let updated = note::update(app.db(), record.clone(), new).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(updated.id, record.id);
    note::destroy(app.db(), updated).await.unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(note::find(app.db(), record.id).await, Err(AppError::NotFound)));
}

/// The edit form shows what was saved: params from a record validate back to it.
#[tokio::test]
async fn the_edit_form_round_trips_a_saved_note() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let record = factories::note(app.db()).await;
    let new = note::NoteParams::from(&record).validate().unwrap();
    let saved = note::update(app.db(), record.clone(), new).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        note::Model {
            updated_at: record.updated_at,
            ..saved
        },
        record
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_duplicate_title_is_a_validation_error() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    let taken = factories::note(app.db()).await;
    let mut params = factories::note_params(app.db()).await;
    params.title = taken.title.clone();
    let new = params.validate().unwrap();
    match note::create(app.db(), new).await {
        Err(AppError::Invalid(errors)) => assert_eq!(errors.on("title"), ["has already been taken"]),
        other => panic!("expected a validation error, got {other:?}"),
    }
}
